verdict.rationale: Atlas docs state some of its coverage before signup: Delaware C corps and LLCs only, automatic EIN (SS-4) and 83(b) filings, and a Delaware registered agent. Nothing in the pack shows it states whether it handles annual-report or franchise-tax filings, and community reports say state and city filings outside Delaware are left to the founder. Price is only evidenced through community comments ("$500"), not a first-party pre-purchase pricing statement. Missing for 10: first-party published pricing, explicit statement of annual-report or franchise-tax filing coverage, a list of which non-Delaware state filings are or aren't included.
